fanOuts.intro: Each published rule version is decided for every business of its level, a batch at a time, behind the global hold. Every regulatory role reads the runs; an admin holds, pauses, resumes, cancels and rolls back.
fanOuts.meaning.running: Deciding the version for each business of its level, a batch of 1,000 at a time.
fanOuts.meaning.held: Stopped at a batch boundary by the global hold; it carries on by itself once the hold is released.
fanOuts.meaning.paused: Stopped at a batch boundary by a person, or by the run itself when too many results flipped; it runs again only when an admin resumes it.
fanOuts.meaning.completed: Every business of the level was decided.
fanOuts.meaning.cancelled: Stopped for good; the decisions it made stay.
fanOuts.meaning.disabled: Published while fan-outs were switched off, so it never ran; each business is decided when its profile next changes.
fanOuts.meaning.failed: A batch kept failing after its retries. The decisions made before it stay.

fanOut.control.cancelDescription: The run stops at its next batch boundary for good. The decisions it made stay; to take them back, roll the version back. The engine keeps your reason in its audit log.

impact.intro: What a rule version, in any status, or a specification no version holds yet would decide for the businesses the engine's directory lists, before anything fans out.
impact.stores: A dry run stores no decision and tells nobody: the engine writes one audit entry with you and the counts. It reads every tenant's profiles, so only an admin runs one.

impact.form.subject: What to run
impact.form.subjectSpecification: A specification no version holds yet

impact.form.levelVersionHelp: The version's own level unless you name it.
impact.form.levelSpecificationHelp: The level of the hierarchy the specification is decided at.

changeImpact.bulk.intro: One change card to each affected client's own people who follow it (an owner or staff), about the client's first open obligation of the change, through the usual queue, quiet hours and batching. Your firm's people hear in the daily digest instead. A person who already has the card for a client gets nothing more.

changeImpact.bulk.cutTitle: Not every affected business is named

changeImpact.bulk.lostBody: The request may or may not have reached the notification service. Try again sends exactly the same request, so nobody is told twice.
